title: Docusaurus EchoBridge live-recording capture plan
description: Launch the real EchoBridge app on its configured iOS simulator, install public-safe local auth fixtures, start a real app recorder session, capture simulator video/screenshot proof, and stop the recorder cleanly.

proofTargets.claim: Farmslot can launch and control the real EchoBridge iOS app through its configured simulator and Metro port.
The demo is captured from a real EchoBridge recorder session with visible timer, waveform, size, pause/stop controls, and Recipe Protocol artifacts.

launch-echobridge.intent: Launch EchoBridge using configured IOS_SIMULATOR/WATCHER_PORT from pool/project/.env defaults.

prepare-public-safe-session.intent: Grant simulator microphone/notification permissions and install public-safe local auth fixtures.

start-live-recording.intent: Start a real EchoBridge recording session through the app bridge and wait for isRecording=true.

record-live-proof.intent: Record the iOS simulator while the EchoBridge recorder timer, waveform, and controls are live; capture final screenshot proof.

stop-live-recording.intent: Stop the recorder after the docs proof media is captured.
